title: DICK'S Sporting Goods Launches First Collegiate Licensed Collections
summary: DICK'S Sporting Goods launched its first officially licensed collegiate collections from VRST, CALIA and DSG, starting with Ohio State and Iowa.
body_markdown:
"We are incredibly excited to feature Ohio State and Iowa, both universities with passionate fan bases, within these collections," said Shane Robinson, Divisional Merchandise Manager at DICK'S. He added that bringing together the schools the company's athletes root for with products from its exclusive brands "was a natural fit."


## Why It Matters for DKS


The release describes the launch as an expansion of the company's vertical brands business into collegiate apparel. "Growing our vertical brands means continuing to find new ways to meet athletes where they are and deliver the styles they're looking for," said Aimee Watters, VP of Vertical Brands at DICK'S. She said partnerships "play an important role in that strategy, helping us reach new athletes and bring our brands into new spaces," and called fan apparel "a natural next step in that growth."


The release calls VRST, CALIA and DSG DICK'S exclusive brands, and the company describes itself as a leading omni-channel retailer. Its banners include DICK'S Sporting Goods, Golf Galaxy, Public Lands and Going Going Gone!, and it also owns and operates the Foot Locker Business, according to the release.
